note: Separates client problem -> delivery result -> adoption result -> business outcome. Business outcomes require evidence and are NEVER promised. Each row names suitable + unsuitable products.

outcome_layers.business_outcome: downstream business effect — EVIDENCE REQUIRED, never guaranteed

rows.verified_problem: website attracts visitors but generates few requests
rows.allowed_outcome: evidence-backed list of conversion gaps + prioritized recommendations (delivery_result)
rows.prohibited_outcome: guaranteed increase in requests/revenue (business_outcome without evidence)

rows.verified_problem: business is hard to find and has no owned online path
rows.allowed_outcome: presence map + gap list + recommended first step

incoming requests are lost or handled slowly
